description: Reference vector for Astrodock push encryption (MOBILE_DESIGN.md section 6). Written by apps/control-plane/src/lib/push.js and checked by test/mobile-unit.mjs. All binary values are standard base64 with padding. Private keys are raw 32-byte X25519 scalars (CryptoKit rawRepresentation); public keys are raw 32-byte X25519 points.

algorithm.keyAgreement: X25519(devicePrivateKey, ephemeralPublicKey) on the phone, X25519(ephemeralPrivateKey, devicePublicKey) on the server
algorithm.hkdfSalt: the 32 raw bytes of the ephemeral public key (envelope.e, decoded)
algorithm.envelope: { v: 1, e: b64(ephemeralPublicKey), n: b64(nonce), c: b64(ciphertext || 16-byte tag) }
algorithm.plaintext: UTF-8 JSON { id, t: title, b: body, a: appSlug|null, an: appName|null, p: path|null }
